description: THE RADIO ROOM — the single most literal piece of evidence for Larry's duty found in the survey. A heavily sandbagged equipment enclosure stands against a mortared-stone wall beneath a timber-framed upper structure: a dark green metal cabinet/shelter roofed with sandbags, and beside it a green DOOR STENCILED 'RADIO' in white, with a small viewing window. Cables and guy wires run in every direction — down the stone wall, across the passage, into the enclosure. At lower right sit storage batteries; a wooden ladder leans in the passage beyond; a giant boulder (with guy-wire anchors) fills the right side, with a white-wrapped equipment box on a stand above it.
visibleText: 'RADIO' — stenciled on the door, FULLY LEGIBLE.

mortared stone construction, timber framing above
